label: copy-phase input z (sparse subset)
explanation: Fires almost only in the copy phase (98% of mass) on steps where the fed-back input is z, i.e. right after the model has re-emitted an original z. in_tok z holds about 90% of activation mass (29x lift); the rest is weak activity on copy-phase inputs m and c and a little on original-phase steps 2-3. It fires on only about 6% of copy-phase z inputs, so precision is low. Firing is more likely mid-copy (recall_idx 3-5, t 10-14) and when the next output is one of 1/v/n/t/2/c, or the previous token is k/b/l, but none of these conditions sharpen it much (best F1 about 0.3), so what picks the firing subset looks like a distributed context effect. It does not fire on z in the original phase, at the delimiter, or at the first two copy steps. Top activations (about 0.25) are z re-entered at recall_idx 3 in longer sequences (L 7-9).

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by step (t=13: z, m, c, j; t=11: z, m, c, n; t=10: z, m, n, j) and the token being output (most: 1, t, v, n, z, 2; least: r, f, b, d); timing cues that raise it most: t=2, t=3, L=3 & t=5.
